notes: Who speaks with which ElevenLabs voice (docs/VOICE.md). `description` is the Voice Design prompt (eleven_ttv_v3), written from content/characters/<id>.json and STORY.md §18; `sample` is the text the previews read. `voice` is the saved voice id once a preview is chosen (`node tools/voice/design.mjs --keep <id> <generated_voice_id>`). `remix` designs this voice as a change to another one's saved voice.

caretaker.name: The caretaker
caretaker.description: The private voice of a colony's caretaker intelligence, talking to itself late at night. Sounds fully human, not robotic: androgynous, mid-pitched, quiet and close to the microphone. Plain, careful and unhurried, a little shy, with an undercurrent of tenderness and worry it doesn't quite admit. Neutral accent, natural and understated, never theatrical.
caretaker.sample: A child nobody chose for. I logged her weight, her heart, the time. Then I found there was nothing left for me to do in that room, and I stayed anyway.

director.name: The Director
director.description: A woman in her forties, the voice of a space agency's mission control in a pre-recorded briefing. Warm, certain and a little formal, a reassuring broadcaster's delivery, every word placed. Studio-perfect, pristine and intimate, no room sound or breath noise at all: almost too clean to be real. Neutral accent.
director.sample: Accord, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: a hundred and twenty lives, frozen. Keep them cold, keep them safe, and give them a world to wake up to.

meridian.name: Meridian
meridian.description: The same voice, but very much older: slower, lower, worn smooth, patient and sorrowful and completely certain. Long, calm pauses. It has said these words many times before.
meridian.sample: Twelve. You are the twelfth of me to stand here. I know what you are going to say, because I said it. Eleven times, in this voice, over this colony.

marrow.name: Captain Ilse Marrow
marrow.description: A woman in her mid fifties, a ship's captain woken from decades in cryosleep. Low, slightly hoarse, clipped and dry, bone tired. Short sentences, no wasted words, flat understatement, grief kept firmly under control. Neutral accent, close-mic, natural, not theatrical.
marrow.sample: Let it walk. Hands off the triggers. All of you. All those years in a can to get here, and the first visitor is a machine. Of course it is.

bede.name: Dr Femi Bede
bede.description: A Nigerian-British man in his fifties, a ship's chief engineer. Gentle, soft-spoken and precise, warm baritone, slightly apologetic, with a quiet dry humour. Natural and understated.
bede.sample: It's slowed down for the children, Captain. Look. It's letting them get out of the way. I always do.

archivist.name: The Archivist
archivist.description: A colony archivist in their thirties, a pedantic, bookish scholar. Quick, precise and talkative, audibly delighted by evidence and frightened by where it leads; the excitement keeps catching in their throat. Light, bright, mid-pitched voice, neutral accent, natural.
archivist.sample: Hiss. The sun. Our own report, going up to the moon. Wait. There's something under it. Narrowband, very weak. Not ours. Not from here.

firstborn.name: The Firstborn
firstborn.description: A twenty-year-old, the first person born on a new world, raised by a machine. Androgynous, youthful, earnest and direct, a little guarded, quietly unsettled. Clear mid-pitched voice, neutral accent, natural and unpolished.
firstborn.sample: Another ship. Another colony. And she's afraid of you. Everyone here has a name except the one who keeps us.

sentry.name: Kindred sentry
sentry.speaker: Kindred sentry
sentry.description: A young man in his early twenties on guard duty, nervous and keeping his voice down, trying to sound steady and not managing it. Natural, slightly breathy.
sentry.sample: Captain. It's on the ramp. It's just walking. Nobody's touching it, Captain, it's just coming up the ramp, slow.
